summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, http_path, client_id, client_secret; secret fields client_id and client_secret; env-var refs for both secrets; auth_type oauth set after profile args). Registered it directly after the token mapping in profile_mappings and in the export lists of cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py and cosmos/profiles/__init__.py. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering the claim check (each required input removed in turn), token selection for login+password, OAuth selection for extra credentials, profile and env-var output, and non-overridable auth_type and secrets. Tests were not run and no repository code was executed, per instructions; changes are verified by reading only. Nothing was committed.
